prompts.clubhouse: Create one wide 16:9 concept image for the actual playable GameNight multiplayer lobby, a clean minimal side-view 2D platformer room. This is stylized-concept game art, not a website, not a presentation, not isometric. Strong art direction, deliberate chunky pixel art, consistent pixel scale, clean silhouettes, limited palette, beautifully composed but restrained detail. Four small friendly original player characters with distinct coral, mint, yellow and violet accents, simple faces suitable for custom avatar replacement. Flat readable horizontal floor and a few reachable elevated platforms; clear open space for jumping. A central large TV on a raised platform has three physical pads below it for resume/play-next/skip; a separate small sign-in stand left of the TV with a blank square for a future real QR code; a music object to the right. Keep screen and sign surfaces blank or simple icons, no fake QR, no text, no browser chrome, no HUD panels. Quieter darker background, crisp illuminated walkable platform edges, interactable objects visually distinct. Actual gameplay-scale characters, no giant foreground portrait. Direction A: cozy late-night clubhouse. Dark navy walls, warm timber, amber lamps, soft CRT teal glow, a modest couch, restrained plants and shelves. Quiet welcoming atmosphere and generous negative space. Polished original indie game aesthetic. The room feels intimate, tactile, and warm; avoid clutter or excessive neon.
